name: Scald (Recharge 6)
description: a creature sprays a 30-foot cone of superheated water. Each creature in the area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) f ire damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone.
